translations.b0246: Part 9  Improving the Regional Economic Layout and Promoting Coordinated Regional Development
translations.b0247: China will leverage the combined effects of the coordinated regional development strategy, major regional strategies, the functional zoning strategy and the new urbanization strategy, advance in a coordinated way the deeper implementation of strategies within regions and the interconnected development of different regions, improve the layout of major productive forces, give play to the role of key regions as growth poles, and build a regional economic layout and territorial space system featuring complementary strengths and high-quality development.
translations.b0248: Chapter 28  Enhancing the Coordination of Regional Development
translations.b0249: China will implement regional development strategies consistently and without letup, take differentiated and categorized measures in light of local conditions and changing circumstances, encourage all regions to leverage their comparative advantages and fully tap their strengths, promote coordinated development among the eastern, central and western regions and between the north and the south, and promote relative balance through development.
translations.b0250: Section 1  Raising the Level of Coordinated Development Among the Eastern, Central and Western Regions and the Northeast
translations.b0251: Focusing on major protection, major opening up and high-quality development, China will make solid progress in advancing large-scale development of the western region to form a new pattern; based on functional positioning, resource endowment and industrial foundations, it will strengthen and expand industries with distinctive competitive advantages, implement a number of major ecological barrier construction projects, and promote opening up both internally and externally through the development of opening up corridors, hub nodes and platform carriers. Based on safeguarding national defense, food, ecological, energy and industrial security, it will push for new breakthroughs in the comprehensive revitalization of the northeast; improve energy corridors and transport networks; continue to consolidate and enhance comprehensive grain production capacity; turn resource advantages in science and education, agriculture and ecology into development outcomes; and accelerate opening up to the north. It will open new prospects for the accelerated rise of the central region, strengthen the capacity to guarantee food and energy and raw materials, improve and strengthen modern equipment manufacturing and high-technology industries, build a comprehensive transport hub system, and advance high-level opening up in inland areas. It will encourage the eastern region to move faster in modernization, strengthen original and disruptive scientific and technological innovation, and lead the building of advanced manufacturing clusters and modern services hubs with international competitiveness.
translations.b0252: Section 2  Consolidating and Enhancing the Role of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region, the Yangtze River Delta and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area as Sources of Growth
translations.b0253: China will further advance the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and form a closer pattern of all-round coordinated development. It will actively, prudently and orderly relieve Beijing of functions non-essential to its role as the capital, continue to ensure the implementation of landmark relocation projects and policies, optimize and enhance the capital’s functions, and build a modern capital metropolitan area. It will advance the building of Xiong’an New Area into a modern city to high standards and with high quality and improve its management system. It will improve the comprehensive service level of Beijing’s municipal administrative center and enhance the comprehensive carrying capacity of the Tianjin Binhai New Area. It will further advance the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta and improve the institutional mechanisms for integrated development in innovation and industrial chains, infrastructure, ecological and environmental protection and other areas. It will accelerate the building of Shanghai’s “five centers,” build the Yangtze River Delta Eco-Green Integrated Development Demonstration Zone to high standards, raise the level of radiation from the Hongqiao International Open Hub, support the integration of Shanghai and Suzhou in key areas, and deepen city-pairing cooperation between Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang and northern Anhui. It will deepen the development of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, strengthen the alignment of rules and mechanisms in scientific and technological innovation, economic development, public services and other areas, strengthen the rule of law safeguards, give full play to the pioneering role of major cooperation platforms, and move faster to build a world-class bay area.
translations.b0254: Section 3  Advancing the Development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt and the Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development of the Yellow River Basin
translations.b0255: China will continue to prioritize ecological conservation and refrain from large-scale development, uphold ecological conservation and green development, and continue to promote high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt. It will strengthen pollution control in key areas and the protection and governance of important lakes, firmly advance the ten-year fishing ban in the Yangtze River, orderly raise the level of collection and treatment of domestic sewage in cities along the river, and work to keep the water quality of the Yangtze’s main stream stable at Grade II and bring the water quality of major tributaries basically up to Grade II. It will keep the Yangtze River golden waterway open and unobstructed, strengthen the high-standard protection and rational, efficient use of shoreline resources, promote the green transformation and upgrading of industries along the river, and promote coordinated and interconnected development of the upper, middle and lower reaches. It will comprehensively promote the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin, continue to improve the pattern of major protection and major coordination, systematically advance water conservation in the upper reaches, soil and water conservation in the middle reaches, and wetland protection and ecological governance in the lower reaches, intensify comprehensive treatment of important tributaries such as the Huangshui and Weihe rivers, and go all out in the tough battle for deep water conservation and water use control. It will further advance the building of pilot zones for the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin.
translations.b0256: Section 4  Supporting the Revitalization and Development of Areas of Special Types
translations.b0257: China will accelerate the revitalization and development of old revolutionary base areas, pass on the red heritage, develop industries with distinctive features, support these areas in leveraging comparative advantages to foster self-sustaining momentum, and deepen paired cooperation between key cities in old revolutionary base areas. It will provide targeted support to border areas by category, coordinate efforts to guard and consolidate the border, invigorate border areas and enrich their people, strengthen border defense, and promote opening up along the border; promote the innovative development of border trade; increase investment in education, healthcare and other fields in border areas; implement stronger border-protection subsidy policies; make solid progress in building key towns and villages along the border; support the development of port cities; and promote high-quality development in border areas. It will support areas with ecological degradation in carrying out ecological restoration and green development. It will advance the transformation and development of old industrial bases and resource-based areas, support resource-depleted cities in developing replacement industries, and promote the comprehensive treatment and integrated use of coal mining subsidence areas and independent industrial and mining areas.
translations.b0259: With major cross-regional and cross-basin corridors as the foundation, the interconnected development of city clusters as the vehicle, and institutional coordination as the guarantee, China will promote mutual integration, mutual reinforcement and mutual benefit among regions and expand the space for domestic circulation.
translations.b0260: Section 1  Improving the Layout for Interconnected Regional Development
translations.b0261: China will strengthen the connectivity of regional infrastructure, advance the building of major cross-regional and cross-basin corridors such as the Yangtze River comprehensive transport corridor and the border and coastal corridors, and give play to the supporting role of major cross-regional projects such as the west-to-east power transmission project and the project to channel computing resources from the east to the west. It will strengthen the integration of city clusters and the coordination and interconnected development of key city clusters, and promote efficient collaboration in regional innovation and industrial chains. It will support the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area in building world-class city clusters. It will raise the development level of the Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone and build it into an important growth pole for high-quality development. It will promote faster development of the city cluster in the middle reaches of the Yangtze River and similar city clusters. It will cultivate and develop a number of regional central cities, support cooperation and development in areas adjacent to provincial borders, and better leverage the supporting and driving role of regions that connect different areas. It will support major economically strong provinces in shouldering greater responsibilities, strengthen reform efforts to tackle tough problems, policy empowerment and the provision of production factors, and encourage them to take the lead and set an example in advancing Chinese modernization.
translations.b0263: China will deepen cooperation across administrative regions and improve mechanisms for inter-regional planning coordination, industrial collaboration and benefit sharing. It will strengthen the coordinated implementation of regional development strategies and the alignment of plans, and jointly advance the building of cross-regional platforms and major projects. It will improve the mechanisms and platform systems for industrial transfer collaboration, explore benefit-sharing mechanisms between industrial transferring and receiving areas in terms of tax revenue, land use and carbon emission allowances, and promote the orderly domestic transfer of key industries. It will support the cross-provincial coordination of construction land quotas within city clusters and metropolitan areas in accordance with plans. It will explore coordinated regional legislation. It will support benefit compensation between the upper and lower reaches of river basins and between resource-exporting and resource-importing areas, and expand models such as river basin economies in light of local conditions. It will move faster to promote high-quality development of areas with large ethnic minority populations, deepen interactions, exchanges and integration among all ethnic groups, improve the working mechanisms for paired assistance to Xinjiang and Tibet, and increase preferential support for southern Xinjiang.
translations.b0264: Chapter 30  Improving the Territorial Space Development Pattern
translations.b0265: China will follow the principle of using water where water is suitable, mountains where mountains are suitable, growing grain where grain is suitable, farming where farming is suitable, developing industry where industry is suitable and developing commerce where commerce is suitable; improve the institutional system of functional zoning; make policies more targeted and precise; and foster a spatial development pattern in which functional zoning constraints are effective and territorial development is orderly.
translations.b0266: Section 1  Strengthening the Implementation of the Functional Zoning Strategy
translations.b0267: China will keep the overall pattern of urbanized areas, major agricultural production areas and key ecological function areas stable, appropriately optimize the main functions of certain areas, and promote the enhancement of the capacity of urbanized areas to accommodate economic activity and population, the improvement of comprehensive agricultural production capacity in major agricultural production areas, and the improvement of the quality of natural ecosystems in key ecological function areas. It will refine and clarify special functional areas and, on the basis of main functions, add functions such as safeguarding national security, ensuring the supply of energy and resources, protecting and passing on culture, and strengthening the protection and utilization of marine resources in light of local conditions. It will improve differentiated support policies and assessment and evaluation mechanisms for different main functional areas and rationally allocate quotas for newly added construction land, water resources and other factors.
translations.b0269: China will improve the territorial space planning system; dynamically improve territorial space plans in accordance with national development plans and in light of the assessment results of territorial space planning; and give play to their foundational role in the development and protection of territorial space. It will implement and optimize control lines such as those for arable land and permanent basic farmland, ecological conservation red lines, and urban development boundaries as well as various types of management and control boundaries, and rationally optimize control objectives in support of the implementation of major national strategies. It will improve the quality of permanent basic farmland, orderly phase out unstable and disaster-damaged farmland and promptly replenish it, study and improve differentiated control of human activities within ecological conservation red lines and differentiated policies for the exploration and extraction of strategic minerals, and optimize urban development boundaries in light of population flows and industrial development trends. It will make coordinated use of nearshore and deep and distant sea space.
translations.b0270: Section 3  Strengthening Coordinated Territorial Space Governance
translations.b0271: China will establish and improve the systems for territorial space use control and planning permission and implement differentiated and refined use control by zone and category. It will improve the mechanism for guaranteeing land for major national projects and give play to the role of the “one map” in natural resource management and territorial space planning. It will give provincial-level governments greater autonomy in coordinating construction land, explore a model for controlling total construction land within planning periods, allow city and county construction land to be coordinated and the ratio of existing to new construction land to be differentiated, without exceeding the provincial total for construction land, and adopt comprehensive land supply that coordinates existing and incremental land. It will promote the organic integration of land use review and planning permission and coordinated approval for the use of land, sea, forest and grassland.
translations.b0273: China will continue to improve the quality of urbanization, promote the full integration of rural migrants into cities, optimize the structure of city sizes, promote connotative urban development, and promote coordinated development and a compact, intensive layout of large, medium and small cities and small towns.
translations.b0274: Section 1  Making Rural Migrants Urban Residents in a Scientific and Orderly Manner
translations.b0275: China will take active yet prudent and categorized steps, deepen reform of the household registration system, and ensure the provision of basic public services at the place of permanent residence in a coordinated way. It will improve the points-based household registration policy for megacities and super-large cities, establish public household registration at the sub-district or community level across the board, and broaden channels for rural migrants with stable employment and residence to obtain urban household registration. It will explore establishing a unified national population management system and gradually achieve household registration at the place of permanent residence. It will steadily increase the proportion of rural migrant workers covered by urban employee social insurance and encourage more cities to include eligible permanent residents without local household registration in the public rental housing guarantee. It will relax, in light of local conditions, the requirements for taking the high school entrance examination in the places where migrants have settled, and enable eligible children accompanying their parents to receive basic education continuously. It will further improve the mechanism that links people with land and funding. It will safeguard the lawful land rights and interests of farmers who have settled in cities, protect in accordance with the law their rights to contract land, to use homesteads and to share in collective returns, and explore establishing a voluntary and paid exit mechanism.
translations.b0276: Section 2  Cultivating and Developing Modern Metropolitan Areas
translations.b0277: China will improve the institutional mechanisms for the integrated development of metropolitan areas and build convenient and efficient commuting circles, tiered and complementary industrial circles, and convenient and shared living circles. It will advance the modernization of governance in megacities and super-large cities, strengthen and refine their core functions, and extend their radiating and driving effects to the common development of surrounding cities and counties. It will advance unified planning, coordinated project layout and coordinated policy-making within metropolitan areas, strengthen the cross-administrative alignment of spatial layouts and land uses, and explore in places where conditions permit the coordination of public resources and production factor allocation with the metropolitan area as the basic unit. It will improve commuting efficiency in metropolitan areas, move faster to connect intercity road sections that remain unconnected or are bottlenecks, and promote the universal redemption of science and technology innovation vouchers and the mutual recognition of years of employment and residence. It will cultivate a number of metropolitan areas in the central and western regions and the northeast and enhance the radiating and driving capacity of central cities.
translations.b0278: Section 3  Building Modern Cities for the People
translations.b0279: China will promote the transformation of the urban development model and build innovative, livable, beautiful, resilient, civilized and smart modern cities for the people. It will implement a special action to stimulate the vitality of industrial innovation and enhance cities’ capacity to originate industrial innovation. It will advance high-quality urban renewal, carry out city health checks, move faster to build complete communities, improve the implementation mechanisms for urban renewal, establish planning adjustment mechanisms suited to the conversion and mixed use of building functions, and build a sustainable investment and financing system for urban construction and operation. It will use urban underground space efficiently. It will promote the green and low-carbon transformation of urban development, improve urban public transport services, improve urban parks, greenway networks and walking and cycling systems, and continue to improve the 15-minute fitness circles. It will accelerate the building of urban infrastructure lifeline safety projects, advance the renovation of old pipelines and dilapidated houses, and improve urban drainage and waterlogging prevention capacity. It will strictly limit super-high-rise buildings and improve fire prevention and rescue capabilities for high-rise buildings. It will strengthen the management of urban appearance and architectural design and encourage urban buildings to better reflect Chinese aesthetics and the spirit of the times. It will strengthen the building of mutually embedded communities. It will advance the all-round digital transformation of cities, improve urban management mechanisms and operation and management service platforms, and make urban governance smarter and more refined.
translations.b0280: Section 4  Advancing Urbanization with County Seats as Key Carriers by Category
translations.b0281: Based on resource endowment, location conditions and development foundations, China will guide the development direction of county seats in counties surrounding large cities, in major agricultural production areas, in key ecological function areas and in land border areas by category, form development paths with distinctive features, and orderly promote the reasonable concentration of population in county seats and central towns. It will strengthen industrial support in county seats in areas with urbanization potential and absorb rural migrants for nearby employment and settlement and for returning to their hometowns to start businesses. It will support county seats in addressing shortcomings in infrastructure and public services, enhance their comprehensive carrying capacity, and strengthen fiscal support at the county level. It will, in due course, adjust and expand the economic and social management authority of county-level cities and super-large towns with large economies and rapid population growth, and prudently optimize the institutions of counties with small populations.
translations.b0282: Chapter 32  Strengthening the Development, Utilization and Protection of the Sea
translations.b0283: China will maintain coordinated land and maritime development, improve its capacity to manage and develop the sea, move faster to build itself into a maritime power, and forge a path of pursuing strength through the sea with Chinese characteristics.
translations.b0284: Section 1  Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy
translations.b0285: China will strengthen, improve and expand the marine industry, orderly advance the development and utilization of marine energy and resources, develop deep-sea aquaculture and modern pelagic fisheries, consolidate and enhance the advantages of the marine equipment manufacturing industry, expand emerging marine industries such as marine biomedicine and seawater desalination, develop modern shipping services, and build cultural and tourism destinations with maritime features. It will strengthen strategic scientific and technological forces in the marine field, strengthen marine scientific and technological innovation, improve the support and guarantee system for deep-sea and polar expeditions, and develop ocean-going meteorological and navigation services. It will implement deep-sea projects and improve the capacity to enter, survey, develop and secure the deep sea. It will strengthen the overall planning of major bays, raise the development level of the northern, eastern and southern marine economic circles, optimize the layout of marine economic development demonstration zones, build modern marine cities with distinctive features, deepen the integrated development of ports, industries and cities in light of local conditions, and encourage coastal and inland regions to strengthen cooperation in the marine economy. It will improve the institutions and mechanisms for promoting marine economic development, increase policy support in fiscal, tax and financial fields, and improve the statistical monitoring system for the marine economy.
translations.b0286: Section 2  Protecting the Marine Ecological Environment
translations.b0287: China will strengthen source prevention of marine environmental risks, advance pollution prevention and control, shoreline and beach improvement, and protection and restoration in key sea areas, and bring the proportion of good-quality water in nearshore waters to around 86%. It will strictly control sea reclamation, fully implement protection requirements for natural shorelines, coastal wetlands and uninhabited offshore islands, and keep the retention rate of natural shorelines on the mainland at no less than 35%. It will strengthen the cleanup and resource utilization of marine litter. It will formulate differentiated standards and specifications for sea use and actively advance the layered and three-dimensional use of sea areas. It will improve the management system for island development and protection and advance island development by category and in an orderly manner. It will carry out a new round of comprehensive marine surveys, improve the marine ecological early-warning and monitoring system, enhance the capacity to prevent and control major marine disaster risks, and guard against seawater intrusion. It will explore marine carbon sink accounting.
translations.b0288: Section 3  Safeguarding National Maritime Rights and Interests
translations.b0289: China will actively promote the building of a maritime community with a shared future, expand blue partnerships, and promote the building of a fair and reasonable international maritime order. It will take an active part in formulating international maritime governance rules and actively implement the Agreement on Marine Biodiversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction. It will strengthen international cooperation in marine scientific research and surveys, disaster prevention and mitigation, and the blue economy, continue to improve multilateral and bilateral cooperation platforms and mechanisms in the maritime field, and promote the establishment of a specialized international maritime organization in China. It will enhance public awareness of the sea, strengthen situation assessment, risk prevention and legal struggle, improve the institutions and mechanisms for safeguarding maritime rights and interests, and enhance maritime law enforcement and maritime judicial capacity.
